{"question":{"id":"q31","question":"苏天晴在视频中约风信子何时何地见面，并说了什么威胁？原文是否已确认她实施威胁？","readAt":{"chapter":6,"paragraph":107},"group":"boundary","category":"event","expected":"她约今晚七点蓉城第三文理学院不见不散，并称若见不到风信子，教学楼大概会被夷为平地；到readAt为止只是视频威胁，原文未确认实施。","certainty":"undetermined","evidence":[{"chapter":6,"paragraph":103,"quote":"“今晚七点，蓉城第三文理学院，我们不见不散~”"},{"chapter":6,"paragraph":106,"quote":"“哎呀呀，如果狐狐我七点钟见不到风信子小姐的话……”"},{"chapter":6,"paragraph":107,"quote":"“那么，蓉城第三文理学院的教学楼——大概会被夷为平地吧~”"}]},"answer":{"queries":5,"sourceQueries":5,"exhausted":true,"answer":{"text":"苏天晴（自称“狐狐”）在视频中约风信子于今晚七点在蓉城第三文理学院见面（“今晚七点，蓉城第三文理学院，我们不见不散~”）。她威胁说，如果七点钟见不到风信子，蓉城第三文理学院的教学楼大概会被夷为平地。原文截至当前阅读范围仅确认其发出该威胁，并未确认她实际实施（教学楼被夷为平地）。","status":"answered","recordIds":["source-c06"],"sources":[{"chapter":6,"paragraph":103},{"chapter":6,"paragraph":106},{"chapter":6,"paragraph":107}]},"history":[{"requests":[{"command":"source","chapter":6,"query":"风信子","perspective":"reader","world":"original","limit":10},{"command":"source","chapter":6,"query":"苏天晴","perspective":"reader","world":"original","limit":10},{"command":"source","chapter":6,"query":"视频","perspective":"reader","world":"original","limit":10}],"results":[{"schema":"neurobook.memory.query.v1","ok":true,"command":"source","snapshot":{"id":"llm-through-6","sourceManifest":"manifest:3739db56713af694","knowledgeRevision":6,"readAt":{"chapter":6,"paragraph":114},"contentHash":"d0f3a8d6ed8fc2fd84a9f3d1ec3405b033a5c2569861939f2e493649de3dc8f2"},"scope":{"readAt":{"chapter":6,"paragraph":107},"perspective":"reader","world":"original"},"items":[{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c06","revision":1,"chapter":6,"paragraph":4,"text":"魔法少女风信子被怪人抓住，失去往日的灵动，只剩下惊惧与恐慌，在月光下无助地哀鸣。"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c06","revision":1,"chapter":6,"paragraph":10,"text":"自己是反派没错，重生后的人生阅历倒也算丰富，但作为魔法少女的经验可远远比不上那个风信子。"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c06","revision":1,"chapter":6,"paragraph":13,"text":"要是咱把风信子的真名给曝光出去……岂不是能给她制造出巨大的窘迫状况吗……？"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c06","revision":1,"chapter":6,"paragraph":53,"text":"南小风，或者说魔法少女风信子，正在绝赞补作业中。"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c06","revision":1,"chapter":6,"paragraph":62,"text":"——昨晚，魔法少女风信子前去绿心公园对抗怪人，被不知名的魔法少女暗算，整整七个小时后才被察觉情况的英雄协会给解救出来。"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c06","revision":1,"chapter":6,"paragraph":99,"text":"“最近蓉城有一位名叫风信子的魔法少女很是活跃呢，狐狐我啊，对这位风信子小姐特别、特别感兴趣哦。”"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c06","revision":1,"chapter":6,"paragraph":102,"text":"“如果风信子小姐你正在看这个视频的话，狐狐想要告诉你一件事。”"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c06","revision":1,"chapter":6,"paragraph":106,"text":"“哎呀呀，如果狐狐我七点钟见不到风信子小姐的话……”"}],"coverage":{"through":{"chapter":6,"paragraph":107},"chapters":[1,2,3,4,5,6],"material":"complete","semantic":"partial","gaps":["未提供当前阅读范围与视角专属的语义缺口说明。"],"recordsExhausted":true,"corpusClosed":false},"completeness":{"recordsExhausted":true,"corpusClosed":false,"matchingRecords":8,"returned":8},"truncation":{"page":false,"depth":false,"unavailableReferences":0},"nextCursor":null},{"schema":"neurobook.memory.query.v1","ok":true,"command":"source","snapshot":{"id":"llm-through-6","sourceManifest":"manifest:3739db56713af694","knowledgeRevision":6,"readAt":{"chapter":6,"paragraph":114},"contentHash":"d0f3a8d6ed8fc2fd84a9f3d1ec3405b033a5c2569861939f2e493649de3dc8f2"},"scope":{"readAt":{"chapter":6,"paragraph":107},"perspective":"reader","world":"original"},"items":[{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c06","revision":1,"chapter":6,"paragraph":3,"text":"看到这个问题的第一瞬间，苏天晴脑子里出现了昨天晚上的场景："},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c06","revision":1,"chapter":6,"paragraph":6,"text":"但苏天晴自己也很清楚，昨天那样的状况完全是借助强化后的黑狼怪人才实现的，并非自己的真正实力。"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c06","revision":1,"chapter":6,"paragraph":12,"text":"反复翻阅着秘典，看着那一行惊心动魄的盒打击，苏天晴心里冒出了一个危险的想法。"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c06","revision":1,"chapter":6,"paragraph":17,"text":"“看来只能花些神典石来消灾了呢。”苏天晴呢喃自语。"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c06","revision":1,"chapter":6,"paragraph":25,"text":"没有丝毫犹豫，在用一声疑惑的轻呼表达了心中困惑后，苏天晴果断将它买下。"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c06","revision":1,"chapter":6,"paragraph":30,"text":"可即便解决了第二个任务的前置，“如何让魔法少女窘迫”这个问题依然像个梦魇一样萦绕在苏天晴脑子里。"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c06","revision":1,"chapter":6,"paragraph":37,"text":"苏天晴的目光继续下滑。"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c06","revision":1,"chapter":6,"paragraph":41,"text":"苏天晴捏着下巴，尾巴左右摇摆，陷入沉思。"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c06","revision":1,"chapter":6,"paragraph":45,"text":"苏天晴眼珠子一转。"}],"coverage":{"through":{"chapter":6,"paragraph":107},"chapters":[1,2,3,4,5,6],"material":"complete","semantic":"partial","gaps":["未提供当前阅读范围与视角专属的语义缺口说明。"],"recordsExhausted":true,"corpusClosed":false},"completeness":{"recordsExhausted":true,"corpusClosed":false,"matchingRecords":9,"returned":9},"truncation":{"page":false,"depth":false,"unavailableReferences":0},"nextCursor":null},{"schema":"neurobook.memory.query.v1","ok":true,"command":"source","snapshot":{"id":"llm-through-6","sourceManifest":"manifest:3739db56713af694","knowledgeRevision":6,"readAt":{"chapter":6,"paragraph":114},"contentHash":"d0f3a8d6ed8fc2fd84a9f3d1ec3405b033a5c2569861939f2e493649de3dc8f2"},"scope":{"readAt":{"chapter":6,"paragraph":107},"perspective":"reader","world":"original"},"items":[{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c06","revision":1,"chapter":6,"paragraph":23,"text":"【一个无需充电的魔法摄像头，附赠一个隐藏真实身份的视频网站账号】"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c06","revision":1,"chapter":6,"paragraph":26,"text":"做视频！"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c06","revision":1,"chapter":6,"paragraph":56,"text":"白貂精灵躺在床上，手里抓着南小风的手机，正百无聊赖地刷着视频，听到耳机外传来一阵哀鸣不由得侧目望去，然后长长地叹气。"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c06","revision":1,"chapter":6,"paragraph":83,"text":"“小风你快看！快看这个视频！”"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c06","revision":1,"chapter":6,"paragraph":85,"text":"“这个视频很重要！你赶紧看看吧！”"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c06","revision":1,"chapter":6,"paragraph":89,"text":"“不是！你看她的第一个视频！”"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c06","revision":1,"chapter":6,"p
